# Play diagram recipe

The TV analysis segment, 16:9. Run the footage at full speed, rewind, freeze on a white flash, then draw on the picture in fluorescent marker: rings under feet, dashed arrows for the ball, a red patch over space nobody covered. Play on, change angle, and finally flatten everything onto a dark board. Real footage is the ground; every line rides on top and moves with it. Studio packaging (corner bug, source clock, score bar, yellow wipe) ties it together.

## Principles

1. See it move first, then dissect it. A freeze always comes after play.
2. One freeze, one finding: a single label and no more than two groups of lines. Reuse the same few seconds, going one layer deeper on each pass.
3. Draw on the real picture. Rings under feet, arrows along the ball's true path. No abstract floating diagram until the film deliberately flattens to the board.
4. Count, never guess. Times come from a stopwatch on source time. If the footage cannot measure it, do not write it.
5. Studio energy: bright marker, white flash, a punch on every freeze.

Not a highlight reel (no montage to music). Not an infographic (the top-down board shows up once, as the summary). Not a documentary (this has a host's packaging and enthusiasm).

## Footage

Use the user's own footage: swap the painted stand-in for `list_media` clips, ideally a wide camera that covers the whole action. Paint a stand-in only when the user has nothing; overlays then sit on it the same way.

One grade for every clip: slightly cool shadows, a vignette (clear to 55%, 40% black at the corners). A freeze adds a cool tint (`--kartu` at 30%) and a slow 1.2% creep.

## Opening, 0-3.2 s

- 0-1.6 s, dark sting: faint pitch-perspective outline, one fat marker stroke drawn across with its arrowhead, big show title punching in with a small spaced line below.
- 1.6-3.2 s, record card over dimmed footage: heading with a yellow bar, a mono tournament line, two names with a big rolling score in a yellow cell, a dotted timeline with one yellow highlight box on the key moment.
- Then a yellow wipe into the footage. Bug, clock and score bar appear only after the card.

## Drawn elements

- Marker line, built in layers: dark outline (width + 6, black 55%), soft glow stroke (width + 16 at 28%), coloured core, thin white highlight (width x0.28 at 55%). Draw it in pieces along its length; the arrowhead pops in over the last 10%. Wobble vertices 2.5 px for a hand-drawn feel. Dashed (26 px on, 18 off) for intended or past paths; solid for what happened.
- Ring: perspective ellipse under the feet, ry = 0.36 r, 19% fill, drawn clockwise in 0.35 s. Outer dashed ring at 1.32x, turning at 60 px/s. Faint vertical light beam above the main player.
- Spotlight: everything outside a focus ellipse drops to 44% (even-odd hole), 0.3 s fade.
- Space patch: red ellipse, 36% fill, dashed edge, tilted about -7 degrees, scaling from its centre in 0.4 s.
- Label card: near-black (90%), 8 px coloured bar at left, heavy headline over a small spaced caption. Size the card to its text; keep it off the action it describes. Reveal left to right over 0.28 s.
- Board page: `--latar` with a faint 60 px grid (7% `--teks`). Text on the left, top-down drawing on the right. Never a centred title with bullets.

## Palette

- `--utama`: the marker. The team or player we follow, the ball, main lines, the yellow wipe, the bug's show block, the score cell. On the board it runs through `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--aksen`: the opponent. Cyan rings and thin link lines (`--aksen-di-latar` on the board).
- Fixed in every brand: space red `--ruang`, chalk white `--kapur` (pitch lines, card text), near-black card `--kartu`, and the stand-in footage's own colours. One colour keeps one identity all film.
- Card and bar text: chalk, or `--teks-di-utama` on a yellow block. No coloured words on the dark card; the bar carries the role colour.

## Type

- `--font-judul`: Oswald 700. Label headlines 42 px, bug name 26 px (3 px tracking), score 36-42 px, stopwatch 54 px, board titles 88 px, row numbers 86 px.
- `--font-isi`: Inter 600/800. Captions 20 px, 3 px tracking, caps. Board rows 38 px bold, note 25 px.
- Source clock: IBM Plex Mono 600, 24 px. Board kicker: mono 24 px.
- No handwriting fonts; printed type on a dark card is part of the packaging. One line per label. Shorten the line before you shrink it.

## Timing

- Freeze entry: white flash 0.12 s (55%), punch 1.035 to 1.0 over 0.35 s `power2.out`, cool tint in 0.15 s, then the 1.2% creep until release.
- Freeze length 1.4-2.4 s. Going longer demands a second action inside it. Draw order: ring (who), then line or patch (what), then label (the finding), spaced 0.3-0.6 s.
- Slow motion at 0.5-0.85x. Rewind in 0.35 s `power2.inOut`, hidden under the wipe.
- Wipe: yellow slanted band (skew -20 degrees) with dark edges, crossing in 0.34 s. It is the sole transition; inside a segment use hard cuts.
- Stopwatch counts for 0.6 s linear, then holds. Score digit rolls up 50 px in 0.35 s with a yellow flash on the bar.
- Draw the ending fully early and hold it 2 s or more.

## Camera

- Punch-in on freeze, 1.035 to 1: "stop, look here". Every freeze.
- Slow creep, 1.2%: keeps the freeze alive. Long freezes.
- Hard cut within a segment: same footage, next layer. Replays, angles.
- Yellow wipe: new segment. Chapter changes, the board.
- Side-by-side windows, 960 px each with a 6 px divider: two angles at once. Comparisons.
- Flatten to the board: the finding as diagram. Summaries.

## Signature moves

- Freeze and draw: flash, punch, tint, spotlight, then ring, line, label. For a coach breaking down a smash or serve, a cooking teacher freezing a knife grip, a creator analysing a gameplay clip.
- Tracked ring: a ring follows a player's feet through play, short dashed trail behind. For a dance teacher tracking one dancer, a school match recap, a scooter-delivery route review.
- Counting stopwatch: starts on one frame, holds on another, in source seconds. For reaction time in a technique, a barista's pour time, a pit-stop breakdown.
- Space patch: red ellipse for what nobody covered, cyan links to the others. For a blocking gap, an empty shelf in a shop walkthrough, crowd flow at an event.
- Packaging throughout: corner bug, source clock and score bar present from frame 0, never fading in; score rolls on the landing frame. For a weekly league recap, a class series, a street-food contest.
- Flatten to the board: findings numbered at left, court redrawn in marker at right. For a lesson summary, a trainer's checklist, a story's map.

## Avoid

- Overlay drifting off players: scale the footage and its overlay layer together so the punch transform is shared.
- Misplaced rings and arrows (the biggest risk): position them on full-size frames, not on a scaled sheet.
- Packaging that fades in over footage exposes the broadcaster's logo. Draw it from frame 0.
- Long trails land wrong when the camera pans. Keep only the last 0.6 s.
- Numbers the footage cannot support (ball speed, distance run).
- A freeze beyond 2.5 s with one drawing feels stuck. Add a second action or release.
- Clipped label text. Size the card to fit.

# Sports play diagram: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 3.8.

## hook

- en: dark sting: a fat yellow marker stroke draws across, the title punches in; then footage freezes on a white flash with ring, arrow, label
- id: sting gelap: coretan kuning melintas dan judul menghentak; lalu footage dijeda dengan kilat putih, sorot, cincin di kaki, panah, satu label

## problem

- en: the same seconds replayed at half speed, frozen where it goes wrong; a red space patch and one finding label
- id: detik yang sama diputar ulang setengah kecepatan, dijeda di titik yang salah; ruang kosong merah dan satu label temuan

## fact

- en: freeze on the moment, a dashed marker line traced over the real path, a stamp-like label under the moving picture
- id: jeda di saat itu, garis spidol putus-putus menelusuri jalur asli, label temuan di ruang kosong gambar

## step

- en: slow replay (0.5x, source clock running), freeze on contact, ring, dashed arrow along the path, one label; one layer deeper per pass
- id: putar ulang pelan (0,5x, jam sumber jalan), jeda di kontak, cincin, panah putus-putus di jalur, satu label; tiap putaran lebih dalam

## compare

- en: yellow wipe to a second angle or side window; our ring in yellow, theirs in cyan, linked by thin dashed lines
- id: pita kuning menyapu ke sudut lain atau jendela samping; cincin kita kuning, lawan cyan, disambung garis tipis putus-putus

## number

- en: a stopwatch card counts source time up and holds on the finding, over a spotlight and a red space patch
- id: kartu stopwatch menghitung waktu sumber lalu berhenti di temuan, di atas sorot dan ruang kosong merah

## proof

- en: play on after the freeze: lines fade, the picture runs to its result and the score bar rolls on the frame it lands
- id: lanjut diputar setelah jeda: coretan hilang, gambar jalan ke hasilnya, papan skor berputar tepat di bingkai pendaratan

## offer

- en: a yellow label card on the freeze naming one thing to do, ring on the key spot, no extra graphics
- id: kartu label kuning di gambar jeda yang menyebut satu hal untuk dilakukan, cincin di titik kuncinya, tanpa grafik lain

## cta

- en: the last freeze or the board page with the contact in the label card, fully drawn early; held 2 s
- id: gambar jeda terakhir atau papan dengan kontak di kartu label, sudah tergambar penuh; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: yellow wipe to the dark board: numbered findings left, top-down court right redrawn in marker; fully drawn, held 2 s
- id: pita kuning ke papan gelap: temuan bernomor di kiri, lapangan dari atas di kanan digambar spidol; tergambar penuh, diam 2 detik
